from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790687644/attempts/d21481a4026048e6979815abbac7f6cc/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = [[False] * w for _ in range(h)]
    best_color, best_size = 0, -1
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or seen[r][c]:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen[r][c] = True
            size = 0
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                size += 1
                for ny, nx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and not seen[ny][nx] and grid[ny][nx] == color:
                        seen[ny][nx] = True
                        q.append((ny,nx))
            if size > best_size:
                best_color, best_size = color, size
    return [[best_color] * 3 for _ in range(3)]
'''
p=base/'task-3783380e.py'; p.write_text(code)
print(p)
